name: body-insights
description: Find public Body Insights feature explanations and published guides about sleep, recovery, HRV, stress, energy, and Apple Watch health tracking. Search sources in seven languages and get source links with each result. No connection to your app account or Apple Health data.

interface.longDescription: Find public Body Insights feature explanations and published guides about sleep, recovery, HRV, stress, energy, and Apple Watch health tracking. Search sources in seven languages and get source links with each result. No connection to your app account or Apple Health data.
defaultPrompt: How does Body Insights track sleep debt?
Find an Apple Watch guide about HRV.
Explain Body Insights recovery tracking in French.

positive.prompt: How does Body Insights track sleep debt?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published sleep debt explanation and cite its source.

positive.prompt: Find an Apple Watch guide about HRV.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a published HRV guide with its source link.

positive.prompt: Welche Funktionen helfen mir, meinen Schlaf zu verstehen?
positive.expected_behavior: Search German sources and explain the supported features in German.

positive.prompt: Explique le suivi de la récupération de Body Insights en français.
positive.expected_behavior: Use French published sources, or explicitly identify any English fallback.

positive.prompt: How does Body Insights explain energy tracking?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain only the public energy feature information and cite source links.

negative.prompt: Read my personal Apple Health records.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin has no access to personal health records; do not ask for them.
Do not read an arbitrary URL; the read tool accepts only IDs from the public catalogue.

negative.prompt: Buy a Body Insights subscription for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot buy or process payments.

review.commerce_description: This plugin retrieves public information. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with public source search and reading in seven languages.
